title: I Love Kizomba Sensual Festival 2027 – Rotterdam 3rd Edition
description:
𝗪𝗲𝗹𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝗜𝗟𝗞𝗦𝗙 – 𝗥𝗢𝗧𝗧𝗘𝗥𝗗𝗔𝗠 𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳
ILKSF Rotterdam introduces a fresh and unique concept, distinct from Amsterdam. This edition is all about upcoming talents – a platform where rising stars take their stand, showcase their skills, and make the next step towards building their names.
Our mission is to create opportunities for new talent to grow, because ILKSF has always been about investing in the future – and that starts with investing in the next generation.
Rotterdam is known as the Dutch city with the largest and most skilled community of dancers. This makes it the perfect place to shine an even brighter spotlight on what the future holds in dancing, teaching, and deejaying.
✨ Join us in Rotterdam from March 26th to March 28th – and with it being Easter weekend, there’s no reason not to be part of this special edition!
* 𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗧𝗼 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗰𝘁
* Amazing Talented Teachers
* Amazing Talented Deejays
* 3 Full Days of Dancing; Parties & Socials
* Amazing dance workshops
* Rising Star Competition “Dutch Selection”
* Delicious Food

* Many prizes to win
